cases.description: The $title of a YAML section is slugged as the content of an ATX heading, ## and the title, so emphasis delimiters, a link's URL and a character reference give the same key as in Markdown (§5.5, decision K8).

The $title of a JSON section is slugged as the content of an ATX heading, ## and the title, so emphasis delimiters, a link's URL and a character reference give the same key as in Markdown (§5.5, decision K8).

A data title is read as a heading's inline content: a line break is a soft break, so one and two on two lines give one-two, and no closing sequence is stripped, so foo # gives foo-, as a setext heading would in Markdown (§5.5, decision Q1, which refined K8).
